dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a high degree of irregularity; a base spline fit shows a concave falcate trend interrupted by three distinct negative-space notches.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is rounded with a small pixel radius, transitioning into a concave trailing edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Smooth convex curve with an approximate 40-degree slope relative to the horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 2.2 times the vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three prominent, jagged notches on the trailing edge: one near the apex, one mid-fin, and one at the lower base. Presence of light-colored mottling and skin lesions on the lateral fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique notched silhouette of the trailing edge combined with localized skin depigmentation patterns.
